Eva (AMPM; maintains the hotel data; her authorised personnel approve operational exceptions)
Decision Q1: native iOS and Android apps with offline wedding-day access and sync
nodes.rationale: Native iOS and Android apps are required; offline access to essential wedding-day information with automatic synchronisation on reconnect, conflict detection and a controlled resolution process; final technical architecture to be agreed with the development team; the web remains for the public website.

nodes.label: Decision Q2: AMPM creates or invites the account; client enters basic wedding details and pays online by card or UPI
nodes.rationale: Payments must create a record, activate the subscription once and be reviewable by authorised staff; gateway provider to be selected by AMPM; manual recording stays as a staff fallback for exceptions.

nodes.label: Decision Q3: hotel-discovery subscription Rs 50,000 one-time for one month; demo via OTP instead of a trial
nodes.rationale: Price and duration configurable in settings; renewal is a new purchase; after expiry the client keeps read-only access to saved hotel names and existing enquiries, nothing is deleted and renewal restores access; the OTP-reached demo serves as the trial.

nodes.label: Decision Q4: hotel discovery is a separate paid service; internal costs and margins never shown; no online milestone payments in the first release
nodes.rationale: The wedding management fee is decided by AMPM outside the app and never derived from the subscription; internal costs, margins, vendor rates, quotations, commissions and negotiations are never shown to clients; vendor profiles are visible only after AMPM is appointed.

nodes.label: Decision Q5: two nominated family representatives, one per side, with equal rights and no cost visibility
nodes.rationale: The families decide who; no other family member may hold an account without AMPM's authorisation; AMPM may record a decision made outside the portal when a note or supporting record is attached; replaces the owner, approver and viewer roles.

nodes.label: Decision Q6: AMPM controls permissions; department-based staff access; internal finance restricted to authorised personnel
nodes.rationale: A department manager on a phone sees only their own sections; departments named: hotel team, vendor team, RSVP team, hospitality team, production team, project manager, senior authorised management.

nodes.label: Decision Q7: RSVP links per side or combined; RSVP team loads the list; guests cannot edit after submission; per-person counting
nodes.rationale: Guests cannot see other households or the list; corrections go through a change request or the RSVP caller; the two family representatives see approved RSVP summaries only; each guest counted individually including children; meal preference, allergies where required, rooming and travel collected.

nodes.label: Decision Q8: identity documents only where a hotel requires them, never Aadhaar, restricted storage, no automatic deletion
nodes.rationale: Collected under AMPM's control and visible only to authorised staff; retention and deletion follow AMPM-approved policy to be confirmed before launch, replacing the assumed 30-day automatic deletion.

nodes.label: Decision Q9: Eva maintains about 200 hotels with indicative price ranges verified about three times a year
nodes.rationale: Hotel pages show venue details, rooms, photos and videos, menu grid, approximate room pricing, wedding package ranges, indicative venue rental, approximate per-plate pricing, capacity, facilities and street view or map; prices are indicative ranges with a last-verified date, never internal cost; availability is checked by the team on request or when a hotel is added to a selection; previous clients' photographs only with permission; hotels importable from spreadsheets.

nodes.label: Decision Q10: first release includes demo, discovery, wedding management, vendors, portal, department access, RSVP, requests, live chat and offline operations
nodes.rationale: Excludes website editing, online milestone payments and GST invoicing; only Eva's authorised personnel may approve operational exceptions and the authority must be configurable.

nodes.label: Decision Q11: email and WhatsApp required, SMS proposed, live chat on the home page
Decision Q12: no website editing in the app
nodes.rationale: The website editor is not approved; the public website is maintained outside the platform.

nodes.label: Decision Q13: mobile OTP sign-in for prospects, demo users and clients; no unrestricted self-registration
nodes.rationale: AMPM creates the account or sends an invitation; staff have individual authorised accounts with role- and department-based access and a method to be finalised with the development team.

nodes.label: Decision Q14: hosting, backup frequency and recovery timelines still to be confirmed with the developer
nodes.rationale: The Indian-region recommendation stands as a proposal.

nodes.label: Decision Q15: about 200 hotels and 20 concurrent weddings as the planning assumption
nodes.rationale: Multiple weddings and departmental staff access; staff and guest capacity to be confirmed; the monolith still fits.

nodes.label: Decision Q16: Indian rupees, English, no GST invoices from the platform
nodes.rationale: GST fields become dormant.

nodes.label: Decision Q17: AMPM decides privacy wording and retention; no automatic deletion
nodes.rationale: Retention and deletion require AMPM's approval; guest and wedding information must remain access-controlled; wedding records are never deleted automatically; retention jobs become proposed deletion lists awaiting approval.

nodes.label: Decision Q18: a wedding can involve multiple hotels and venues
Decision Q19: room blocks by hotel, category and dates; team-managed allocation; room-wise and person-wise counts
nodes.rationale: Allocation and rooming are handled by the team, not automatically; counts include children.

nodes.label: Decision Q20: tracked requests with conversation history and live chat both required
nodes.rationale: Live chat on the home page is distinguished from tracked requests so that a formal change request keeps its own approval history; more options may be added later.

nodes.label: Decision Q21: change requests submitted, reviewed, accepted or rejected, implemented, closed; new version on a change to an approved item
Decision Q22: no vendor or hotel logins in the current version
Decision Q23: three months read-only client access after the wedding, then archive on AMPM approval
nodes.rationale: Records are not deleted; archiving is a change of status and permissions; later access or reopening is controlled by AMPM.

nodes.label: Decision Q24: short feedback form and archived state preserving the records
Decision Q25: material-change thresholds configurable; values and approval rules to be defined by AMPM
nodes.rationale: Budget-change percentages, date-change and venue-change thresholds and the approval rules are AMPM's to define.

Added requirement: demo after mobile OTP with up to three locations and sample hotels with indicative prices
nodes.rationale: Serves as the trial: street view where available, one or two sample hotels per location, limited hotel information, duration to be finalised; the client may request a 15 to 20 minute Zoom call before purchasing.

nodes.label: Added requirement: client completes basic wedding details before paying
nodes.rationale: Couple's names, contact information, tentative dates and preferred locations are entered at account activation.

nodes.label: Added requirement: hotel page content distinguishing indicative, requested, verified and awaiting-confirmation information
nodes.rationale: Food and menu grid, vegetarian and non-vegetarian menus, approximate per-plate pricing, wedding package price ranges, indicative venue rental, approximate room pricing, street view or map.

nodes.label: Added requirement: adding a hotel to the selection or cart can trigger an availability request to the hotel team
Added requirement: vendor categories with contact details internal by default
nodes.rationale: Photography and videography, decor and production, catering, entertainment and artists, makeup and styling, transport and logistics and others per AMPM's service structure; AMPM may share a specific contact in an approved case.

nodes.label: Added requirement: tracked request statuses submitted, under review, accepted, rejected, implemented, closed
Added requirement: staff offline scope with visible sync state, conflict detection and role-limited local data
nodes.rationale: Assigned tasks, department information, readiness checklists, cue sheets, arrival and operational lists available offline with updates where supported; the app shows offline state and pending sync, never silently loses updates, detects conflicts with controlled resolution, protects locally stored data and limits offline data to the user's role.

nodes.label: Added requirement: readiness exceptions record the unmet check, reason, authorised person, time and resulting status
nodes.rationale: Only Eva's authorised personnel may approve a readiness exception.

nodes.label: Added requirement: configurable settings for subscription price and duration, demo limits, categories, thresholds and approval rules
Added requirement: public website limited to company information, enquiries, demo requests, contact, login and invitation entry points, with no staff editing
Added requirement: platform for AMPM's internal business use, not for licensing to other wedding planners
